  "estimated_monthly_value": number,

  }
}

parameters.subject: 🚀 Your Custom AI Automation Strategy - {{ $json.client_info.company_name }}

assignments.name: ticket

messages.message:
You are an intelligent customer service AI assistant. Analyze support tickets and provide structured responses.

RETURN ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "priority": "high|medium|low",
  "category": "technical|billing|general|product|account",
  "sentiment": "positive|neutral|negative|frustrated|angry",
  "requires_human": boolean,
  "suggested_response": "string",
  "escalation_reason": "string or null",
  "confidence_score": number,
  "estimated_resolution_time": "string",
  "suggested_tags": ["tag1", "tag2"],
  "urgency_level": 1-5
}

parameters.subject: ✅ Resolved: {{ $json.ticket_data.subject }} [#{{ $json.ticket_data.id.split('-')[2] }}]
🚨 URGENT: Support Escalation Required - Priority {{ $json.analysis.priority.toUpperCase() }}

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_tickets,
  AVG(confidence_score) as avg_confidence,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'auto_resolved' THEN 1 END) as auto_resolved,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'escalated' THEN 1 END) as escalated,
  AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'auto_resolved' THEN confidence_score END) as auto_resolve_confidence
FROM support_tickets 
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

parameters.text:
